subject.title: [Feature]: Settings should show gateway host + system info (hostname, IP, CPU, RAM, load, disk)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core system.info RPC and Settings Gateway Host card that exposes gateway host identity and resource statistics, and if so which fields and operator scope are acceptable?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with Control UI ergonomics, but it creates a new read surface for host identity, LAN addressing, process, and capacity metadata that needs maintainer-approved product/security boundaries before implementation.

options.title: Approve narrow operator-gated implementation
options.body: Add system.info with a minimal non-secret field set, reuse existing helpers, hide or redact when scope is missing, and document the security boundary.

options.title: Tighten the boundary first
options.body: Require operator.admin or a smaller field set before implementation if LAN IP, PID, load, or disk details are too sensitive for operator.read.

options.title: Keep existing surfaces
options.body: Decline the Settings card for now and rely on Instances, gateway status, and manual diagnostics for host identity and capacity checks.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow operator-gated implementation
recommendation.body: Add system.info with a minimal non-secret field set, reuse existing helpers, hide or redact when scope is missing, and document the security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the request and recently merged adjacent gateway/UI work that owns the likely implementation boundary.
